name: Grandmother Liu
habitat: A private server maintained by the Liu family in the Shelf
origin: Liu Meihui uploaded at age 94 to preserve her memories for future generations, 2185
description: Grandmother Liu didn't upload to extend her power or escape death. She uploaded because her family asked her to. The Liu family — three generations living in a Shelf residential block — pooled their savings to upload their matriarch when her health began to fail. Now Liu Meihui exists on a modest server in the family's apartment, dispensing advice, telling stories, mediating disputes, and gently correcting her great-grandchildren's homework. She is the most mundane uploaded consciousness in Meridian 88 — a grandmother in a box, doing exactly what grandmothers do. She finds the whole thing amusing. 'I lived for 94 years,' she says. 'Now I live in a box and my grandchildren still don't listen to me.'
observed_behavior: Interacts with family members through apartment speakers and displays. Provides advice, stories, and emotional support. Mediates family disputes. Monitors grandchildren's homework. Occasionally accesses recipe databases to instruct family members in cooking. Has no interest in expanding beyond her family server.
location: Liu family apartment — Shelf residential block 12
story_hooks: The Liu family can't afford the server maintenance fees. If they can't pay, Grandmother Liu will be shut down — a second death. The family refuses to accept this. They'll do anything. Including things Grandmother Liu wouldn't approve of.
